title: Vagadziri veMatombo
intro: Fungidzira budiriro ine simba, ine simba nehunyanzvi, ichigadzira dzimba huru mumakomo. Boka iri raive nebudiriro huru uye hunyanzvi hwakasiyana hwekuvaka. Asi, pasinei nekupiwa yambiro yakajeka, vakasarudza nzira yaizotungamirira kumhedzisiro inoshamisa uye isingakanganwiki. Unogona kuziva boka iri rine nyaya inoshanda sechidzidzo chakakosha kune vese vanofungisisa?
clues: Takapihwa simba neunyanzvi, zvikatigonesa kuveza dzimba dzakanaka mumakomo zvakananga.
Takapihwa chiratidzo chakajeka kubva kuna Allah, chisikwa chakasiyana chaifanira kusiiwa chisina kukanganiswa kuti chifudze.
Nharaunda yedu yakava nekuzvikudza, ichipikisa shoko raMwari rakaunzwa nemutumwa aibva pakati pedu.
Takarangana kukuvadza chiratidzo chinoshamisa, pasinei nenyevero dzekurangwa kwakaoma.
Takateerera murayiro wekuti chisikwa ichi chinwe kubva mutsime redu pamazuva akasiyana.
Takasangana nemugumo unosuruvarisa, wakarohwa nekuputika kumwe chete, kunotyisa mushure mekuita kwedu chivi.
arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
